notes: Two taḥwīl branches: «قالا حدثنا» joins the first two names; «ح» starts the second; «كلهم عن» after the second branch's co-transmitters makes the names from «بريد» on the shared tail of both branches (rule 3)
«أبو أسامة» stands twice in the text: occurrence 1 in the first branch, occurrence 2 in the second
«محمد بن العلاء أبو كريب» is written as one man with a kunya and a name (rule 7)
